definition_status: Search vocabulary from ONTOLOGY.md; no regulatory classification rules activated

concepts.label: Waterproofing failure
concepts.definition: Report discussions of waterproofing systems and failures; a discovery concept, not an automatic diagnosis.

concepts.label: Water ingress
concepts.definition: Recorded or assessed unwanted moisture entry; observation and cause must remain distinct.

concepts.label: Membrane termination
concepts.definition: Report discussion of membrane edges, upturns and termination interfaces.

concepts.label: Drainage and overflow
concepts.definition: Recorded drainage conditions, water retention or overflow details.

concepts.label: Planter box
concepts.definition: A planting enclosure; use source-backed instances for a particular location.

concepts.label: Roof
concepts.definition: A roof element described by a source.

concepts.label: Balcony
concepts.definition: A balcony or terrace; an alias is discovery context, not proof of equivalence.

concepts.label: Concrete
concepts.definition: Concrete material or construction described in a source.

concepts.label: Cracking
concepts.definition: Recorded or assessed cracking; no severity or causation inferred from this term.

concepts.label: Fire related finding
concepts.definition: Source-backed discussions of fire-related performance or work.

concepts.label: Building Class 2
concepts.definition: Building/part classification candidate. Requires versioned original definitions, sourced facts and reviewed rules.

concepts.label: Concrete finish Class 2
concepts.definition: A concrete finish classification within its specification/standard context; separate from building classification.

concepts.label: Membrane Class 2
concepts.definition: A membrane classification in its standard/product context; separate from building and finish classes.

concepts.label: Apartment use
concepts.definition: A use candidate. This term alone does not establish a building class.
